entities.summary: Trey Hendrickson is an American professional football linebacker for the Baltimore Ravens of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Florida Atlantic Owls and was selected by the New Orleans Saints in the third round of the 2017 NFL draft. Hendrickson signed with the Bengals in 2021 and won the 2024 Deacon Jones Award after leading the NFL in sacks that season.
